fixed.base_rank: ranks 501-1500 by trailing median daily dollar volume (panel median_dollar_vol), eligible names
fixed.sector_neutral: PIT gsector (WRDS ratios), unknown sector = own group
fixed.rebalance: monthly at the panel's month-end decision dates

costs.primary: per name per month: max(Corwin-Schultz round-trip spread capped at 20%, the engine's flat band schedule 6/10/18/35 bps); flat band where CS is missing; charged as |trade| x spread / 2 on ACTUAL traded weight, book and base alike; the market leg (FF mktrf + rf) is costless
costs.sensitivity: flat band schedule only, same turnover scaling

selection_rule: Among the 18 variants, choose the one with the highest t (3-month blocks, hold month) of (book net - base net, primary costs) over the DESIGN window; ties -> smaller active share. Nothing else is read before the choice.
decision_rule: CANDIDATE iff, for the ONE chosen config over VALIDATE 2009-2016 (hold month), book net - market (primary costs) has mean > 0 AND t (3-month blocks) >= 2 AND is positive in >= 5 of the 8 hold years. Else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH if the mean is > 0, FAILED_VARIANT if <= 0. 2017-2024 is read last and is labelled NOT a clean holdout (the library's rules were written on the 2016-2026 vendor calendar). If CANDIDATE: register ONE forward shadow (tilt on the current rank 501-1500 equal-weight base, bar-defect screen on) plus the untilted base as its matched comparison, kill line sized from the active return's sd. Otherwise register nothing.
market: FF daily mktrf + rf compounded over (decision date, next decision date] (momentum_on_crsp.spy_series)
statistics: 3-month blocks keyed on the hold month (crsp_rebuild.window_stats); MDE = 2.8 x SE
why: revision_tilt_2026-09-29.md HIGHEST-EV: move the base, not the tilt; the names where net_raises found its twin gap; equal-weight base because no cap-weighted index tracks there
inputs_reused_from: revision_tilt_inputs_RT_2026-09-29T1110Z.parquet (same panel/fund/bridge/cs runs; it holds every eligible name, not only the top 500)
primary_scheme: equal (the verdict reads the equal-weight base)
